title: Buildings by ward, and where they cluster
description: Detected buildings per ward and per km², and the dense clusters that mark trading centres. A count of buildings, not of households or people.
notes: Overture Maps buildings, release 2026-10-21.0 (ODbL): OpenStreetMap, Microsoft and Google detections, conflated. Source imagery and edit dates run 2014 to 2026; detection misses buildings and under-counts recent growth.
